docs/NATIVE.md records the full macOS showcase build and 2 successful native tests, rerun after theme propagation was fixed. Compilation alone does not establish individual interaction behavior. iOS validation is incomplete.

Successful test "native catalog opens real button examples" searches Button, opens the component, asserts the title Button and presence of button-primary, and expects no failures. It does not click the Button or assert its action.

Successful test "native AI reasoning replays from the shared clock" taps ai-reasoning-replay, advances 2500 ms and asserts ai-reasoning-0-content, then advances 4700 ms and asserts ai-reasoning-replay; expects no failures.

Recorded manual check: immediate native Accordion captures after theme toggles showed consistent sidebar, content and text colors in both schemes. This establishes limited theme rendering evidence, not Accordion disclosure interaction or accessibility coverage.
Recorded manual browser check in VALIDATION.md: Model Selector Arrow Down and Enter selected GPT-5 mini and dismissed the menu. Limited to the documented sample and gestures.

Recorded manual browser check in VALIDATION.md: Context opened on keyboard focus, exposed content and closed with Escape; its values fit the 256 px popover at desktop and 390 px widths. Limited to the documented sample and gestures.
Recorded manual browser check in VALIDATION.md: Inline citations opened on keyboard focus, exposed content and closed with Escape. Limited to the documented sample and gestures.

Accordion and AccordionMultiple from the beta.4 archive passed a browser interaction test for single and independent expansion. Focus moved between triggers with ArrowDown. At a 390px viewport, browser measurements confirmed 16px heading, content and chevron insets with no horizontal document overflow; hover retained its underline. These are targeted web checks only.

A targeted web test in the 28-test website run checked tokenized text, wrap interaction, copy feedback and retained text after mobile resize. Browser checks confirmed wrapping without document overflow at 390px; the UTF-8 downloaded file matched the original 337-byte code passed to the clipboard. Clipboard write succeeded with browser write permission granted. No new native checks are claimed.

The 0.2 release candidate passed 34 browser interaction tests, including theme choices, code-copy feedback reset after three seconds, repeated mobile dashboard/sidebar opening, package-manager commands and shared component demonstrations. The production web build includes all catalog entries. This is targeted coverage, not full variant certification.

At 390px, pointer activation changed Switch from on to off, Space changed it back to on, and a pointer press on the disabled Switch left the shared state unchanged. The documentation article retained 24px side insets without document overflow.

The same Contract website was compiled for macOS and manually checked through Home, Blocks and Dashboard, repeated Back/Forward navigation, disabled history endpoints, page titles, immersive blocks and the globe opening the equivalent website URL. The delivered Mac archive was signature-checked and its downloaded SHA-256 matched the approved artifact. This does not certify every native component.

Eight isolated package tests cover fields, Escape, optional close controls, four edges, initially open content and reopening during exit. Real pointer checks verified all four entry/exit translations and synchronized backdrop fades; mobile reduced-motion checks observed no intermediate movement.

iOS simulator interactions and recording checks cover all four authored window-level Sheet edges, absent handles, close controls and entry/exit motion. Native accessibility and physical-device performance validation remain incomplete.
Five isolated web checks cover failed-image recovery after source changes, legacy fallback, clamped counts, account-menu selection and Escape, keyboard navigation and existing text dropdown behavior.

Beta.5 follow-up: with idle activation held, real first-pointer clicks at 1440px and 390px activated the built app, opened the Avatar menu and focused Profile. This targeted web check does not establish native behavior.
The updated Avatar compositions have not received targeted native validation.

Unreleased local iOS simulator checks covered the Dashboard and Sidebar 01 previews: the shared Back bar hides on downward content scrolling and reappears on upward scrolling. Dashboard table scrolling and return to the catalog were also exercised. This is limited preview-navigation evidence, not full block, device or accessibility validation.

Ten isolated browser checks cover full-window geometry from a transformed clipped container, repeated opening, focus and Escape, initial visibility, non-modal Toast, Drawer dragging and keyboard snap points, point normalization and zero web SafeArea insets. Pointer checks also verified backdrop dismissal and Alert Dialog background blocking. Six Sheet checks cover form persistence and four edges.

Thirteen isolated browser checks passed, including detached insets, controls and focus without a handle, controlled snap points across resize, and scroll-to-full-height with fixed content and footer. Native and motion checks are recorded separately.

Targeted desktop and mobile browser checks cover repeated trigger toggling, outside dismissal, internal theme changes and Escape. A public Popover check verifies edited input persists after outside dismissal and reopening.

Targeted archive tests cover toast stacking, actions, loading persistence and completion, Hover Card and four Tooltip sides. Browser geometry and pointer motion were checked. Mac interactions were checked for Toast, Tooltip and Hover Card. iOS compilation and archive validation completed; device interactions were not rechecked for this release.
No release-specific iOS or macOS build or interaction checks were run for the current nine-family batch or shared area-gallery updates. Earlier native evidence remains historical.

The local beta.5 candidate passed 59 browser tests: 45 historical scenarios, three component-pager checks and eleven targeted tests for the nine updated families. Coverage includes disabled/keyboard Accordion, mixed/group Checkbox, Card validation and cover rendering, Attachment previews/retry/removal, Bubble actions/collapse, Breadcrumb links/menus/mobile Drawer, Badge languages/links, and Chart values, visible-series totals, formats and RTL. Card and AspectRatio test screenshots were inspected. This is partial web coverage; no new native validation is claimed.
